```{r}
# Load required package
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

# ---- USER INPUT ----
file_path <- "C:/Users/jmf7ak/OneDrive - University of Virginia/25_SPRING/12_11_12_persister_mutant _gc_fixed.xlsx"   # change this
sheet_name <- 1                 # or specify sheet name
# --------------------
```

```{r}
# Read the full data range B37:LT102
raw_data <- read_excel(
  path = file_path,
  sheet = "12_12",
  range = "B37:LT98",
  col_names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# Convert to numeric matrix
data_mat <- as.matrix(raw_data)
storage.mode(data_mat) <- "numeric"

# Indices
x_row_index <- 1      # Excel row 37
data_start_index <- 3 # Excel row 39

# X values
x_values <- data_mat[x_row_index, ] / 3600

# Data to average
data_to_avg <- data_mat[data_start_index:nrow(data_mat), ]

# Average every 4 rows
n_groups <- nrow(data_to_avg) / 4
averaged_data <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_groups, ncol = ncol(data_to_avg))

for (i in seq_len(n_groups)) {
  rows <- ((i - 1) * 4 + 1):(i * 4)
  averaged_data[i, ] <- colMeans(data_to_avg[rows, ], na.rm = TRUE)

# ---- SET COLUMN NAMES ONLY HERE ----
rownames(averaged_data) <- c(
  "PA14_05840",
  "PA14_24640",
  "PA14_23250",
  "PA14_06720",
  "PA14_25210",
  "PA14_22350",
  "PA14_61680",
  "PA14_WT",
  "PA14_20200",
  "PA14_blank",
  "PA14_42740",
  "empty_1",
  "PA14_46320",
  "empty_2",
  "PA14_16690"
)

}
```

```{r}
# Identify the blank row
blank_row <- "PA14_blank"

# Subtract PA14_blank row from all rows
averaged_data_corrected <- averaged_data
averaged_data_corrected[rownames(averaged_data) != blank_row, ] <-
  averaged_data[rownames(averaged_data) != blank_row, ] -
  averaged_data[blank_row, ]

# (Optional) remove the blank row afterward
averaged_data_corrected <- averaged_data_corrected[
  rownames(averaged_data_corrected) != blank_row,
]

rows_to_remove <- c("empty_1", "empty_2")

# Keep only rows NOT in rows_to_remove
averaged_data_corrected <- averaged_data_corrected[!rownames(averaged_data_corrected) %in% rows_to_remove, ]
```

```{r}
df_long <- averaged_data_corrected %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Strain") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Strain,
    names_to = "TimeIndex",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

# Replace TimeIndex with real time values
df_long$Time <- rep(x_values, times = nrow(averaged_data_corrected))


p=ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Time, y = Value, color = Strain)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (hours)",
    y = "Normalized 0D600",
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
p
ggsave(
  filename = "C:/Users/jmf7ak/OneDrive - University of Virginia/25_SPRING/PERSISTER/Mutant_growth_curve.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```

growth_norm_vector <- last_col / wt_value

growth_norm_vector
